d: Steven Rinella returns to the Yturria Ranch in south Texas, this time, to hunt turkeys and pigs with country.

t: Alaska Black Bear with Evan Felker

d: Steven Rinella travels to Tanzania for his first African safari with professional hunter, Morgan Potter.

t: Dangerous Game: On Safari in Tanzania
d: Steve continues his African safari with guide Morgan Potter, dodging deadly snakes to find a cape buffalo.
In the Africa series finale, Steve pursues sable and warthog and shares dinner with a ranger and his family.

st: Into the Clouds: Sitka Blacktail Deer
d: Steven Rinella charters a float plane to drop off on a remote lake in Alaskas coastal rainforest for a solo.

st: The Sweetest Meat: Alaskan Black Bear
d: As summer turns to fall, Steve heads into the backcountry of Alaska's Chugach Range.

st: The Waters Edge: Waterfowl in Alaska
d: For a waterfowler's dream hunt, Steven Rinella joins his friend, wildlife biologist Brandt Meixell, on a remote trip to some untouched Alaska wetlands in search of ducks and geese.  With a spread of decoys and a loyal retriever, they try to get their limit and fill their bellies with willow-spit roasted whole duck.

st: The Rugged Peaks: Alaskan Mountain Goat
d: Every year, a handful of hunters draw a mountain goat permit to hunt the Mills Creek region of Alaskas Kenai.

st: Brotherhood, Badlands, and Pack Llamas: Montana Mule Deer
d: With a trio of cantankerous, spit-hurling pack llamas, Steven heads out.

st: The Roughest Country: Texas Aoudad Sheep
d: Steven Rinella heads into the mountainous desert backcountry of west Texas after Barbary sheep, or Aoudad. These introduced sheep from North Africa are hard to find and harder to hunt. Challenged by the harsh environment, rugged terrain, and elusive sheep, Steve finds this hunt to be one of the most difficult he has ever undertaken.

st: Canyon Bottoms and Cookouts: Texas Javelina
d: Steven Rinella takes to the canyons of the West Texas desert in search of javelina. In this broken, rocky terrain finding these unique critters isn't easy and getting a clear shot on a skunk pig with a bow is a whole other story. But Steve is inspired by the evidence of he finds of ancient hunters that used the area to prepare a meal that honors both the animal and our hunting ancestors.
